issues.description: The recommendation "přiřadit vybranému týmu garantů 1–2 moduly jako ‚povinné‘" is a concrete, prescriptive action (including a numeric recommendation) that is not supported by the provided retrieved excerpts. The cited excerpt about Microsoft Learn (kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_54_1) describes Microsoft Learn as a suitable platform and suggests focusing on an area, but does not state an exact staffing or module-count assignment for guarantors.

The KB describes functionality but does not prescribe cadence.
issues.required_fix: Qualify this as a suggested pilot cadence based on local constraints and label as general background knowledge, or remove the specific cadence if a citation cannot be provided.

issues.description: The suggested duration for Minecraft Education demonstrations ("30–45 min") is not present in the retrieved excerpt (kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_15_2). The KB mentions trying a free Hour of Code lesson and discussing with students but does not provide a recommended exact duration.
issues.required_fix: Remove the exact duration or mark it explicitly as a rough guideline (general background knowledge). Alternatively, cite an explicit recommendation if available.
